001: Hello, I would like to open an account at your bank.
Good afternoon. Of course, what type of account are you interested in?
I need a regular checking account for everyday expenses.
I see. For that, you only need your passport and tax ID number.
Great, I have my passport with me. Can I get the tax ID number right here?
No, the tax ID number is issued by the tax office, but you can bring it later.
002: Could you tell me how to transfer money to a card from another bank?
You can do that through the mobile app in a couple of minutes.
Is there a fee for such a transfer?
Transfers within our bank are free, but to another bank there is a small fee.
I see, and what exactly is the fee?
Usually one percent of the amount, but no less than thirty rubles.
003: I would like to get a credit card with a grace period.
Okay, how much do you need and for how long?
Fifty thousand rubles is enough, for a term of one year.
We can offer you a card with a grace period of up to one hundred days.
That's convenient. What documents are required for this?
Just your passport and proof of income for the last three months.
004: Hello, my payment through online banking is not going through.
Let's figure it out. Did you try restarting the app?
Yes, I restarted it, but the error still appears.
I see. It might be a problem with the daily transaction limit.
Can you increase this limit right now?
Yes, of course. I'll raise it to one hundred thousand rubles. Will that be enough?
005: Tell me, can I withdraw cash from my card at your branch?
Of course, any ATM in the lobby will work for that.
Is there a limit on cash withdrawals per day?
Yes, the standard limit is fifty thousand rubles per day.
I need to withdraw forty thousand, so that's fine.
Then it's simple. Insert your card and follow the instructions on the screen.
006: I would like to close my old account and transfer the money to a new one.
Okay, for that you need to write an application and check the balance.
How long does such an operation take?
The transfer usually takes one business day.
That works for me. Do I need to make an appointment in advance?
No, you can do it right now at any window.
007: Could you tell me how to set up automatic payments for utility bills?
It's very simple. You need to go into the app and select the service.
Can I set up automatic payment every month?
Yes, you set the date and the amount, and the payment goes through on its own.
Great, that's very convenient. What if the amount changes?
You can change the settings or cancel the payment at any time.
008: Hello, I would like to put money into a deposit with a good interest rate.
Excellent choice. Right now we have a deposit at eight percent per year.
What is the minimum term for the deposit?
The minimum term is three months, but the longer the term, the higher the rate.
I see. Can I withdraw the interest every month?
Yes, that option is available, and it doesn't affect the principal amount of the deposit.
009: I'm having a problem with mobile banking, I can't log into the app.
Let's check. Are you sure you're entering the correct password?
Yes, I'm sure, but the system says the password is incorrect.
Then let's restore access using an SMS code sent to your number.
Okay, I received the message with the code. What do I do next?
Enter the code in the app and come up with a new, strong password.
010: Tell me, can I pay for tuition through your bank without a fee?
Yes, if the university is our partner, no fee is charged.
How can I find out if the university is on the partner list?
You can check that in the app or on our website.
Great, I'll check. Will the payment details be there?
Yes, all the details will be pulled up automatically, you just need to enter the amount.
